e35298e890e65a876504f280fa18faa6f4893a16.content: While gravity exerts twice as much force on the 10 kg stone ($F = mg$), its inertia ($m$) is also twice as large. Since acceleration is $a = F/m = mg/m = g$, the mass cancels out completely! In a vacuum, all objects fall with the exact same acceleration $g$.
